The primary analysis explains the observed result with verified evidence and a complete account of the method.

The first test records each input and compares the result with the documented behavior. Every recorded value remains within the accepted range.

The second test repeats the process under sustained load. It confirms that the system keeps the same ordering and does not lose any completed work.

The review checks the generated report against the source records. This check gives the team an independent measure of the final result.

The implementation also handles interrupted work safely. A new run resumes from the last complete record and does not duplicate earlier operations.

These results apply to the supported configurations in the release. The compatibility table lists each tested system and its expected behavior.

The conclusion describes the practical effect and the checks that confirm it.
